2-2:
if self.per_channel:                                     # weight — 채널별 대칭
    qmax = 2 ** (self.bits - 1) - 1
    amax = x.detach().abs().flatten(1).amax(1).view(-1, *[1] * (x.dim() - 1)).clamp(min=1e-8)
    return fake_quant(x, amax / qmax, 0.0, -qmax, qmax)
if self.calib:                                           # 보정 — 범위만 기록하고 그대로 통과
    self.lo = torch.minimum(self.lo, x.detach().min())
    self.hi = torch.maximum(self.hi, x.detach().max())
    return x
lo, hi = min(float(self.lo), 0.0), max(float(self.hi), 1e-8)   # 활성값 — 텐서 하나 · 비대칭
qmax = 2 ** self.bits - 1
s = (hi - lo) / qmax
return fake_quant(x, s, round(-lo / s), 0, qmax)

t0 = time.time()
opt = torch.optim.SGD(model.parameters(), lr=lr, momentum=0.9, weight_decay=5e-4)
sched = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(opt, epochs * ((len(Xtr_u8) + 127) // 128))
for ep in range(epochs):
    model.train()
    for xb, yb in batches(seed=ep):
        loss = F.cross_entropy(model(xb), yb)
        opt.zero_grad(); loss.backward(); opt.step(); sched.step()
    model.eval()
    if on_epoch:
        on_epoch(ep, model)
return time.time() - t0
